## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] Tested relevant behavior in a browser/device, where applicable

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real payment data included.
- [ ] No UPI PIN collection or payment-processing behavior introduced.
- [ ] Camera streams and uploaded images remain client-side.

## Additional context

Add screenshots or notes if they help reviewers. Remove or redact personal and payment information.
